definitionZh: CSS 边框间隔属性将相邻单元格的边框之间的距离设置在一个表格中。 此属性仅在边界碰撞分离时适用 。
sourceDefinition: The border-spacing CSS property sets the distance between the borders of adjacent cells in a table. This property applies only when border-collapse is separate.
